answer: A tide of per-task receipts records who did what, and the hollow of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. What survives to the cipher is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, held in escrow until finality, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
